import.poms: Points of measure from a sheet…
import.held: Importing needs the import rights (run imports and upload files): ask an administrator.

fills.poms: Code, name, kind, body zone, unit, default tolerance, how to measure and the body point of each point of measure.
fills.rules: A grade rule per line: its scale and base size, then the increment of a point between two sizes ("50-52") or of every step ("*").

hint.RELATIVE: Each increment goes from one size to the next; the standard increment covers every step a row leaves empty.
hint.ABSOLUTE: Each increment counts from the base size; the standard increment is multiplied by the places from the base.

held.alreadyActive: Some of these are already in use.
held.alreadyArchived: Some of these are already archived.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.noManage: Changing the libraries needs product.styles.manage (a product developer's role).

read.forbidden: Your role does not read these.
read.internal: Something went wrong reading this. Try again.
read.signed_out: You were signed out: sign in again.
read.unavailable: The server cannot be reached right now.
read.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment and try again.
read.contract: The server answered in a way this page does not understand.

write.codeTaken: This code is already in the library (whatever the letter case).
write.internal: Something went wrong saving. Nothing was saved.
write.inUse: It is in use, so this cannot change.
write.invalid: Something in it was refused. Check the fields.
write.moved: Someone else changed it meanwhile: read it again, then make your change.
write.state: It cannot change in the state it is in now.
write.signed_out: You were signed out: sign in again.
write.rate_limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
write.unavailable: The server cannot be reached: nothing was saved.

poms.intro: The points every measurement spec and grade rule is measured at: a code that means the same on every style, how to measure it, its unit and the tolerance a spec takes by default.

status.archiveBody: An archived point is not offered to new specs and rules; the specs and rules that have it keep it.
status.restoreBody: A restored point is offered to new specs and rules again.

notice.picture: The picture of {code} is on file.
notice.pictureScan: The picture of {code} is being checked: it shows once it is clean.

poms.offline_one: Offline: {count} change waits on this page and is sent when the connection is back.
poms.offline_other: Offline: {count} changes wait on this page and are sent when the connection is back.

empty.title: No points of measure yet
empty.body: Add the first point (chest width, back length …), or import them from a sheet.

filteredEmpty.title: No rows match these filters
filteredEmpty.body: Clear the filters to see every point.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to points of measure
forbidden.body: Reading them needs product.styles.view (product developers, production and quality have it).

dialog.inUse: In use: {specs} spec(s) with {values} value(s), {rules} grade rule(s), {templates} measurement template point(s). Its kind and unit stay as they are.
dialog.unused: Nothing uses it yet: every field may change.

field.companyHint: Every company shares a point; or keep it to one company.
field.codeHint: 1 to 40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores ("CHEST_W"): the final inspection records by it.
field.name: Name
field.kindHint: Garment: what the finished garment measures (a spec, a grade rule). Body: what a rider measures.
field.toleranceHint: Taken by a spec when its own is not typed; empty: typed per spec.
field.bodyHint: The rider's measure this garment point follows (garment chest ↔ body chest).
field.howToHint: Plain words a fitter or an inspector follows; the picture shows it.

picture.open: How to measure {code}: see the picture
picture.title: How to measure {code}
picture.failed: The picture cannot be shown right now.
picture.problem: The file store did not take the picture: try again.

problem.name: Give it a name.
problem.tolerance: A tolerance is a number of 0 or more, at most 2 decimals.
problem.code: 1 to 40 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or a digit.
problem.codeTaken: This code is already in the library (whatever the letter case).
problem.inUse: In use: it stays as it is. Make a new point instead.
problem.moved: Someone else changed this point meanwhile: it was read again.

held.archived: This point is archived: restore it to change it.

poms.readOnly: You can look at this point; changing it needs product.styles.manage.

rules.intro: Reusable increments per point of measure between the sizes of a scale: a spec is typed in its base size and graded to the others by a rule.

status.archiveBody: An archived rule is not offered to new specs; the specs graded with it keep their values.
status.restoreBody: A restored rule is offered to new specs again.

empty.title: No grade rules yet
empty.body: Make the first rule for a scale, or import them from a sheet.

filteredEmpty.title: No rows match these filters
filteredEmpty.body: Clear the filters to see every rule.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to grade rules
forbidden.body: Reading them needs product.styles.view (product developers, production and quality have it).

rules.newIntro: A rule belongs to one size scale. Its increments are typed next, in the rule itself.
rules.newAfter: Next: the increments per point and size step.
rules.companyHint: Every company shares a rule; or keep it to one company.

field.codeHint: Capital letters or digits, with . _ - / inside ("GR-JACKET-EU").
field.name: Name
field.baseHint: Where grading starts: the size a spec is typed in.

problem.code: 1 to 60 capital letters or digits, with . _ - / inside.
problem.name: Give it a name.
problem.base: Pick a size of the scale.
problem.bothWays: {code} has a step from {from} to {to} and back: give it one way only (the other way takes the increment off).

rules.readOnly: You can look at this rule; changing it needs product.styles.manage.

held.archived: This rule is archived: restore it to change it.

rules.dropped_one: {count} step does not start at the base size {base}: an absolute rule leaves it out on Save.
rules.dropped_other: {count} steps do not start at the base size {base}: an absolute rule leaves them out on Save.

grid.title: Increments per point and size step
grid.introRelative: Type the increment from one size to the next (negative too). An empty step takes the standard increment.
grid.introAbsolute: Type each size's increment from the base size (negative too). An empty one takes the standard increment times its places from the base.
grid.standardTip: The standard increment: used for every step a row leaves empty.
grid.empty: No points yet: add the first one below.

add.noPoint: Every garment point is in the rule
add.stepLead: A step between two sizes (between fits too):
add.there: This step is already a column.

grades.title: What it grades to
grades.intro: Each size's offset from the base size {base}, as grading reads the increments above.
grades.notReached: No step reaches this size: grading leaves its value as it is.

scaleTab.title: Grade rules for this scale
scaleTab.intro: The rules bound to this scale. Open one to see or change its increments.
scaleTab.emptyBody: Make the first grade rule for this scale.

spec.title: Measurement spec
spec.intro: Points of measure × sizes of revision {revision}, graded from the base size.
spec.missingTitle_one: {count} value still missing (approval needs every point in every size)
spec.missingTitle_other: {count} values still missing (approval needs every point in every size)
spec.legend: The base size {base} is marked; a dot marks a value typed by hand among graded ones; "missing" is a value the range still asks.

menu.fill: Fill from the base by an increment…

frozen.released: Revision {revision} is released and frozen: its spec is read only.
frozen.obsolete: Revision {revision} is obsolete and frozen: its spec is read only.

held.archived: The style is archived: its spec does not change.
held.frozen: This revision is frozen: its spec changes only in a new revision.
held.approved: The spec is approved: reopen it to change it.
held.archivedSpec: This spec is archived: it never changes.
held.noManage: Changing the spec needs product.bom.manage (a product developer's role).
held.rule: The style's edit rule holds changes in this lifecycle state (Product settings).
held.noRange: The style has no size range yet: set it in the Overview first.
held.notDraft: Only a draft spec is approved.

banner.archived: The style is archived: its measurement spec is read only.
banner.approved: The spec is approved: its values are read only. Reopen it to change them.
banner.archivedSpec: This measurement spec is archived: it is read only.
banner.noManage: You can read the spec; changing it needs product.bom.manage.
banner.rule: The style's edit rule holds changes in its lifecycle state: the spec is read only (Products › Settings).

spec.offline_one: Offline: {count} value waits on this page and is sent when the connection is back.
spec.offline_other: Offline: {count} values wait on this page and are sent when the connection is back.

empty.title: No points of measure yet
empty.body: Start the spec of revision {revision}: its base size and grade rule, or a copy of an earlier spec.
empty.held: This revision has no measurement spec.
empty.points: Add the points this style is measured at, each with its value in the base size.

notice.settings: Base size and grade rule saved.
notice.approve: The measurement spec is approved: the final inspection measures against it.
notice.reopen: The spec is reopened: its approval is cleared.
notice.archive: The spec is archived: a new one can be started.

problem.nominal: A value is above 0, with at most 2 decimals.
problem.notNumber: Not a number: the value stays.
problem.moved: The spec changed meanwhile: it was read again.
problem.state: The spec cannot change now: it was read again.

start.title: Start the measurement spec of revision {revision}
start.intro: Type the base size's values; a grade rule fills the other sizes.
start.copy: A copy of an earlier spec of this revision

field.baseHint: The size the values are typed in (the style's base size).
field.ruleHint: A rule of the style's size scale; none: every size typed by hand.

settings.title: Base size and grade rule
settings.baseHint: Grading starts here; the values already typed stay.
settings.ruleHint: Apply grade rule offers this rule first.

addDialog.title: Add points of measure
addDialog.intro: Garment points of the library; give each its value in the base size {base}.
addDialog.none: Every garment point of the library is in the spec.
addDialog.noTolerance: No default tolerance: type it after

held.value: Give each ticked point its value in the base size (above 0).

grade.title: Apply grade rule
grade.intro: The rule's increments from the base size {base}: see what changes before anything is written.
grade.ruleHint: The rules of the style's size scale.
grade.pickFirst: Pick a rule to see what it changes.
grade.overwrite: Overwrite them with the graded values
grade.failed: Couldn't read what the rule changes
grade.kept_one: {count} value typed by hand is kept.
grade.kept_other: {count} values typed by hand are kept.
grade.notReached_one: {count} size is not reached by the rule (left as it is): {cells}.
grade.notReached_other: {count} sizes are not reached by the rule (left as they are): {cells}.
grade.outOfRange_one: {count} value would be 0 or less (left as it is): {cells}.
grade.outOfRange_other: {count} values would be 0 or less (left as they are): {cells}.
grade.notInRule: Not in the rule (left as they are): {codes}.
grade.noBase: No value in the base size {base}, so not graded: {codes}.

pasteDialog.title: Paste from a sheet
pasteDialog.intro: One line per point: its code, then a value per size in the range's order ({sizes}) — or a first line naming the sizes.
pasteDialog.hint: Tabs or semicolons between the cells; an empty cell is left as it is.

held.nothing: Nothing in it fits the spec.

pasteProblem.unknown: "{code}" is not a point of this spec.
pasteProblem.over: {code}: more values than sizes (the extra ones are left out).
pasteProblem.notNumber: {code}, size {size}: "{text}" is not a value above 0.

fill.title: Fill {code} from the base
fill.intro: From the base size {base}: each size before or after it moves by the increment. Values typed by hand stay unless you untick them.

toleranceDialog.title: Tolerance of {code}
toleranceDialog.intro: Under and over the value, in {unit}, for every size that has a value.

held.number: A number of 0 or more, at most 2 decimals.
held.noValues: This point has no values yet.

removeDialog.title_one: Take {count} point out of the spec
removeDialog.title_other: Take {count} points out of the spec
removeDialog.body: Its values in every size go with it. The library keeps the point.

approve.title: Approve the measurement spec of revision {revision}
approve.body: {points} point(s) × {sizes} size(s), none missing. Once approved, the final inspection measures against it and it changes only after it is reopened.

reopen.title: Reopen the measurement spec of revision {revision}
reopen.body: Its approval is cleared; the final inspection no longer measures against it until it is approved again.

archive.title: Archive the measurement spec of revision {revision}
archive.body: It is kept, read only; a new spec of this revision can then be started (a copy of it, too).
